lines.cap: He hit it big one night, and it ruined his life.
lines.say: He hit it big one night, and it ruined his life.

lines.cap: Christmas 2002. Jack Whittaker, a businessman from West Virginia, won the Powerball jackpot. Three hundred and fifteen million dollars.
lines.say: Christmas 2002. Jack Whittaker, a businessman from West Virginia, won the Powerball jackpot. Three hundred and fifteen million dollars.

lines.cap: He took over ninety million in cash, and gave millions away. Churches, a foundation, strangers.
lines.say: He took over ninety million in cash, and gave millions away. Churches, a foundation, strangers.

lines.cap: But he became a target. Hundreds of lawsuits, and begging letters every day. Someone stole over half a million dollars in cash from his car.
lines.say: But he became a target. Hundreds of lawsuits, and begging letters every day. Someone stole over half a million dollars in cash from his car.

lines.cap: The worst came later. His granddaughter, who he spoiled with money, died at just seventeen.
lines.say: The worst came later. His granddaughter, who he spoiled with money, died at just seventeen.

lines.cap: Within a few years, he said the money was gone.
lines.say: Within a few years, he said the money was gone.

lines.cap: He said, I wish I'd torn that ticket up.
lines.say: He said, I wish I'd torn that ticket up.

lines.cap: Money can change your life. It can't fix it.
lines.say: Money can change your life. It can't fix it.
